next.reason: 1985: 'Format 2 is used for files in random access mode or for files in dynamic access mode when records are to be retrieved randomly.' 2023 §2023:14.9.30.3 SR6 bars ADVANCING, AT END, NEXT, NOT AT END, PREVIOUS under ACCESS MODE RANDOM; §2023:14.9.30.4 GR19: without an implicit or explicit NEXT or PREVIOUS 'the read is a random read and the rules for format 2 apply'; §2023:14.9.30.3 SR9 implies NEXT in dynamic mode only when ADVANCING/AT END/NOT AT END is written (phrases 1985 format 2 never had). §2023:14.9.30.2 labels 'Format 2 (random)'. A conforming 1985 format-2 READ means the same.
